focus.title: Pick what each rider trains
focus.body: The focus decides which abilities grow fastest. Match it to the rider's type: a focus his type is weak in barely moves, no matter the intensity. Leave it blank and your assistant picks one that fits.

runToday.title: Train once a day
runToday.body: Press this and the squad trains right away. Skip it and your assistant runs the same session automatically when the day closes. The outcome is the same either way. Hard intensity gains more but leaves riders tired for their next race.

runNow.title: Run today's training
runNow.body: Run now trains the whole squad today, including riders without a day: they train what your assistant picks for their type. Pressing it gives no bonus. Skip it and your assistant runs the same session automatically.

runTodayDayClose.title: Run today's training
runTodayDayClose.body: Press this to run today's training now instead of waiting. It is the same training as the automatic run, with no bonus: the day also runs on its own once the last race is done.

runNowDayClose.title: Run today's training
runNowDayClose.body: Run now trains the whole squad today, including riders without a day: they train what your assistant picks for their type. It is the same training as the automatic run, with no bonus: the day also runs on its own once the last race is done.

runStatus.title: Train once a day
runStatus.body: This line shows today's training: whether it has run, or when it can. When the day can be run, the button that runs it appears right here.

nextUp.title: Where the training shows up
nextUp.body: This bar is how close the rider is to his next whole +1 in the focus ability. Nothing changes on his card until it fills, so read the bar, not the day. That +1 is what he takes into his next race.

focusPanel.title: Focus for {name}
focusPanel.signalStrongTitle: This rider's primary or secondary type supports these abilities, so training here goes furthest and fastest.
focusPanel.signalWeakTitle: Both of this rider's types work against these abilities, so there is very little room to grow them.
focusPanel.noRisk: No risk of losing progress at any intensity
focusPanel.note: A focus develops its own abilities fastest. The rest keep improving more slowly, so a rider grows across the board, just fastest in the direction you choose.

dayPanel.title: Training day for {name}
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_rest: Fatigue drops the most. No growth.
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_recovery: Fatigue drops a little. A little growth on recovery.
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_skill: Low load. Craft only, and it builds slowly.
dayPanel.dayTypeNote_training: Physical abilities, at the level of the session.
dayPanel.noSession_rest: A rest day has no session. Your rider does not train, and his fatigue comes down faster than on any other day. Whatever session he was on is kept, so one click puts him back on it.
dayPanel.noSession_recovery: Active recovery has no session. Your rider spins easy: fatigue comes down, though less than on a full rest day, and he gains a little on recovery. It is the only day that lowers fatigue and still develops something.
dayPanel.sessionNote_vo2max: Climbing and punch at an even share.
dayPanel.sessionNote_vo2max_climb: Punch is not trained. Climbing gains more instead.
dayPanel.sessionNote_vo2max_punch: Climbing is not trained. Punch gains more instead.
dayPanel.sessionNote_cobbled_sectors: Built for the pavé. Cobbles gains most, durability and positioning come along for the price.
dayPanel.sessionNote_echelon_drills: Built for crosswinds. Flat gains most, positioning and durability come along for the price.
dayPanel.sessionNote_attack_repeats: Built for racing aggressively. Aggression gains most, punch and acceleration come along for the price.
dayPanel.note: A session carries its own effort, so you no longer set that separately. Skill days build craft at a fixed, slower rate, whatever the rider is built for.
dayPanel.pickSession: Pick a session in step 2 first.

programs.cellsIntro: Each day has five race-day cells. The weekday's session fills them. Change single cells to choose how many are recovery.
programs.seededHint: Shows what the rider trains now. Your first change saves it as his own plan.
programs.listNote: Tap a program to see its week. It is copied into Plan, so you can change any cell after.
programs.pickTarget: Pick a rider or group first
